home.title: Let's check your crops
home.tipText: Ensure to water your crops early morning to prevent evaporation.
home.tipText1: Water crops early in the morning to reduce evaporation and leaf stress.
home.tipText2: Remove infected leaves quickly and keep them away from healthy plants.
home.tipText3: Check the underside of leaves for pests before they spread.
home.tipText4: Leave enough space between plants so air can move through the crop.
home.tipText5: Avoid watering leaves at night because moisture can help fungi grow.
home.tipText6: Clean pruning tools between plants to reduce disease transfer.
home.tipText7: Rotate crops between seasons to lower soil-borne disease risk.
